grades.lower_bound_mechanism: large-prime erasure: replace term x by m=Rp^k with identical support on primes <= a_1, proved for all terms by induction with boundary repair
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: L = product of primes <= a_1; membership invariant under m -> m+L for all m >= a_1; T = count of terms in [a_1, a_1+L-1]
grades.notes: Complete and correct. Section 1 proves the support characterization (C). The lemma erases primes > a_1 via m=Rp^k, fully general induction including the m=A boundary case, giving (F). Section 3 assembles global periodicity from threshold a_1 and counts T in a full window, yielding a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n. Computations properly separated from proof.
